title: Heavy Duty Grapple Bucket for Skid Steers
body_html:
The Skid Steer Heavy Duty Grapple Bucket is built for tough cleanup and material handling jobs where durability matters. Designed for skid steers up to 65 HP, this bucket features 1/2" thick tines, dual 2" x 10" cylinders, and a 6" x 3/4" cutting edge for dependable clamping and long wear life. The open-tine bottom allows dirt and small debris to fall through, making it ideal for clearing brush, logs, rocks, and construction debris.

Key features

  • Available in widths from 60" to 84"
  • Designed for machines up to 65 HP
  • Optional weld-on teeth and bolt-on edge
  • 1/2" thick tines with dual 2" x 10" cylinders
  • 6" x 3/4" cutting edge
  • Bolt-on sides included
